newsitem.title: USA: National Patent, General Physics sued.
newsitem.headline: National Patent, General Physics sued.

text.p: A complaint has been filed in state court in Delaware challenging National Patent Development Corp's proposed acquisition of 48 percent of General Physics Corp's common stock, the two companies said Thursday.

The complaint alleges that National Patent and the board of directors General Physics have breached their fiduciary duties to General Physics' minority stockholders by approving the acquisition, the companies said.
The companies did not disclose who filed the complaint in Court of Chancery in Delaware.
The companies denied the allegations and said they will defend against the lawsuit.
National Patent announced last week that it had agreed to acquire the rest of General Physics in a deal valued at about $26 million.
Under the deal, National Patent is to acquire the remaining 5,039,732 shares it does not own, or 48 percent of General Physics' shares.
